row:
I love massage therapy!!  
This channel will cover all things that are massage therapy related. Topics such as massage techniques, pro-tips, business information, ethics, motivation, recommended products used in the field and much, much more. Topics are geared to the beginning massage student, but can absolutely be useful for an experienced professional. 
My goal is to provide value to massage therapy students from all over the world through education, inspiration and love.
